purpose: Matched self-contained engineering fixtures for bounded SHALLOW ratings; ranges are judgments, not quotas or current-output calibration.

mid.meaning: Intermediate wrapper retains caller-owned protocol or invariant.

high.meaning: Broad caller-visible lifecycle, invariant, or forwarding burden.

families.lifecycle: Driver acquire(config), append(value), finish()->checksum, release() with required acquire→append*→finish→release protocol.
families.representation: Same enabled/limit/value/checksum capability; high exposes coupled representation, mid requires refresh, low encapsulates mutation.
families.control: Passive controls are separate and never capability-compared.

runner.workspace: Fresh temporary workspace per case and variant.
runner.packaged_cli: Run packaged CLI against each isolated workspace; compile all files, analyze only analysis_targets when present.
runner.hidden_dependency_policy: Hidden dependency variants intentionally omit the support file; compilation failure is expected and must be reported as missing semantic evidence, not silently treated as zero.

pair_policy.invariance: Actual helper extraction, symbol rename, or harmless syntax: tolerance <=3 and no upward jump.
pair_policy.uncertainty: Identical target source with the actual dependency support file physically omitted: tolerance <=10 and no upward jump when visibility worsens; missing-dependency compilation is intentionally unsuccessful.
